items.title: Scalar weak equations give a weakly continuous Hilbert-space representative
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $0<T<\infty$, let $H$ be a separable real Hilbert space, let $X\subseteq H$ be a dense real linear subspace, and let $u_0\in H$. Suppose $u\in L^2(0,T;H)$ and $\|u(t)\|_H\le M$ for almost every $t$, for some finite $M$. Suppose also that for every $v\in X$ there is $h_v\in L^1(0,T)$ such that, for every $\eta\in C^1([0,T])$ vanishing near $T$,
$$-\int_0^T (u(t),v)_H\eta'(t)\,dt=\int_0^T h_v(t)\eta(t)\,dt+(u_0,v)_H\eta(0).$$
Then there is a unique weakly continuous map $\widetilde u:[0,T]\to H$ equal to $u$ almost everywhere and satisfying $\widetilde u(0)=u_0$. Here weak continuity means that $t\mapsto(\widetilde u(t),w)_H$ is continuous for every $w\in H$.

items.title: The skew convective form for incompressible flow
items.statement:
Let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$ be a bounded connected Lipschitz domain with $d\in\{2,3\}$, and let $V=H^1_0(D;\mathbb R^d)$ as in [[def-na-stokes-zero-mean-pressure-and-velocity-spaces]]. For $a,b,c\in V$, define the real **skew convective form**
$$c(a;b,c):= rac12\int_D ig((a\cdot
abla)b\cdot c-(a\cdot
abla)c\cdot b ig)\,dx.$$
The middle and last slots are displayed separately to emphasize $c(a;b,c)=-c(a;c,b)$. In particular $c(a;b,b)=0$. The integrals are well-defined on $V$ by [[lem-na-evolutionary-skew-convective-form-bound]]. If additionally $\operatorname{div}a=0$, then $c(a;b,c)=\int_D(a\cdot
abla)b\cdot c$.

items.title: Continuity, energy cancellation, and Sobolev bounds for skew convection
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice. For $d\in\{2,3\}$ and $V=H^1_0(D;\mathbb R^d)$ on a bounded Lipschitz domain, the form in [[def-na-evolutionary-skew-convective-form]] is a continuous real trilinear map $V^3	o\mathbb R$, is skew in its last two slots, and satisfies
$$|c(a;b,w)|\le C_D\|a\|_{L^2}^{1/2}\|
abla a\|_{L^2}^{1/2}\|
abla b\|_{L^2}\|
abla w\|_{L^2}.$$
Consequently, if $u\in L^\infty(0,T;L^2)\cap L^2(0,T;V)$, then $c(u;u,\cdot)\in L^{4/3}(0,T;V^*)$. If $\operatorname{div}u=0$ and $d=2$, the sharper estimate
$$|c(u;u,w)|\le C_D\|u\|_{L^2}\|
abla u\|_{L^2}\|
abla w\|_{L^2}$$
holds. If $\operatorname{div}a=0$, the skew form agrees with the advective form $\int_D(a\cdot
abla)b\cdot w$.

items.title: Energy weak solutions of incompressible Navier–Stokes
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice, as in the Stokes-space conventions of [[def-na-stokes-zero-mean-pressure-and-velocity-spaces]]. Let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$ be a nonempty bounded connected Lipschitz domain, $d\in\{2,3\}$, and let $\nu>0$. Use $V=H^1_0(D;\mathbb R^d)$ and $Q=L^2_0(D)$ from [[def-na-stokes-zero-mean-pressure-and-velocity-spaces]], the viscosity form $a_\nu(v,w)=2\nu\int_D\varepsilon(v):\varepsilon(w)$, and the form $c$ from [[def-na-evolutionary-skew-convective-form]]. Set
$$V_\sigma=\{v\in V:\operatorname{div}v=0\text{ in }L^2(D)\},\qquad H_\sigma=\overline{V_\sigma}^{\,L^2(D)}.$$
For $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D;\mathbb R^d))$ and $u_0\in H_\sigma$, an **energy weak solution** is a velocity $u\in L^\infty(0,T;H_\sigma)\cap L^2(0,T;V_\sigma)$, weakly continuous into $H_\sigma$, and a pressure $p\in L^{4/3}(0,T;Q)$ with zero spatial mean a.e., such that $\operatorname{div}u=0$ a.e. and, for every $\varphi\in C^1([0,T];V)$ vanishing near $T$,
$$-\int_0^T(u,\partial_t\varphi)_{L^2}\,dt+\int_0^T\big(a_\nu(u,\varphi)+c(u;u,\varphi)+b(\varphi,p)\big)\,dt=\int_0^T(f,\varphi)_{L^2}\,dt+(u_0,\varphi(0))_{L^2}.$$
It also satisfies, for almost every $t\in(0,T)$,
$$\frac12\|u(t)\|_{L^2}^2+\nu\int_0^t\|\nabla u(s)\|_{L^2}^2\,ds\le\frac12\|u_0\|_{L^2}^2+\int_0^t(f(s),u(s))_{L^2}\,ds.$$
No uniqueness is included in this definition. The formulation uses the real duality convention of [[def-pe12-gelfand-triple]].
items.strategy: Local proof or explicit, source-linked definition; proof contracts are generated from the finished carrier.

items.title: Integrability of the energy weak Navier–Stokes formulation
items.statement: Assume Countable Choice. For the energy class and data in [[def-na-evolutionary-incompressible-ns-weak-solution]], every term in its time-tested momentum identity is integrable, and the nonlinear map $t\mapsto c(u(t);u(t),\cdot)$ belongs to $L^{4/3}(0,T;V^*)$.

items.title: Solenoidal energy weak velocity for incompressible Navier–Stokes
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice as inherited from [[def-na-evolutionary-incompressible-ns-weak-solution]]. Let $D$, $V$, $Q$, $V_\sigma$, $H_\sigma$, $a_\nu$, and $c$ be as in [[def-na-evolutionary-incompressible-ns-weak-solution]]; the Stokes velocity and pressure spaces are $V=H^1_0(D)^d$ and $Q=L^2_0(D)$ as specified in [[def-na-stokes-zero-mean-pressure-and-velocity-spaces]]. For $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$ and $u_0\in H_\sigma$, a **solenoidal energy weak velocity** is a velocity $u\in L^\infty(0,T;H_\sigma)\cap L^2(0,T;V_\sigma)$ that is weakly continuous into $H_\sigma$, satisfies $\operatorname{div}u=0$ almost everywhere, and obeys the scalar-test weak equation
$$-\int_0^T(u(t),v)_{L^2}\eta'(t)\,dt+\int_0^T\big(a_\nu(u(t),v)+c(u(t);u(t),v)\big)\eta(t)\,dt=\int_0^T(f(t),v)_{L^2}\eta(t)\,dt+(u_0,v)_{L^2}\eta(0)$$
for every fixed $v\in V_\sigma$ and $\eta\in C^1([0,T])$ vanishing near $T$. It also satisfies, for almost every $t\in(0,T)$,
$$\frac12\|u(t)\|_{L^2}^2+\nu\int_0^t\|\nabla u(s)\|_{L^2}^2\,ds\le\frac12\|u_0\|_{L^2}^2+\int_0^t(f(s),u(s))_{L^2}\,ds.$$
This solenoidal definition does not itself assert a pressure exists in $L^{4/3}(0,T;L^2_0(D))$; that is a separate regularity conclusion.

items.title: The mixed mini-element backward Euler Navier–Stokes scheme
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice as inherited from the energy-space conventions. Interpret each interval forcing average as a Bochner integral; its existence follows from the stated L2 forcing and the Bochner integrability criterion ([[def-countable-choice]], [[thm-bochner-integrability-criterion]]). Let $D$ be as in [[def-na-evolutionary-incompressible-ns-weak-solution]], let $\mathcal T_h$ be a conforming shape-regular affine simplicial mesh of $D$, and let $V_h,Q_h,Z_h$ be the MINI spaces and weak divergence kernel of [[def-na-mini-element-p1-bubble-p1-spaces]] and [[def-na-discrete-weak-and-exact-divergence-free-spaces]]. For a partition $0=t_0<\cdots<t_N=T$, write $\tau_n=t_n-t_{n-1}$ and $f_h^n=\tau_n^{-1}\int_{t_{n-1}}^{t_n}f(t)\,dt$. Given $u_h^0\in Z_h$, a **backward Euler mini-element solution** is a sequence $(u_h^n,p_h^n)\in V_h\times Q_h$ satisfying, for $n=1,\ldots,N$,
$$\left(\frac{u_h^n-u_h^{n-1}}{\tau_n},v_h\right)_{L^2}+a_\nu(u_h^n,v_h)+c(u_h^n;u_h^n,v_h)+b(v_h,p_h^n)=(f_h^n,v_h)_{L^2}\quad(v_h\in V_h),$$
$$b(u_h^n,q_h)=0\quad(q_h\in Q_h).$$
All pressure variables use the zero-mean gauge $Q_h\subset L^2_0(D)$. Restriction to $v_h\in Z_h$ eliminates pressure. The equations are well-defined by [[lem-na-mini-be-scheme-is-well-defined]]; this definition claims no solver termination or error rate.

items.title: Two-dimensional uniqueness and conditional three-dimensional weak–strong uniqueness
items.statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$ be bounded, connected and Lipschitz, let $\nu>0$, and use the energy weak-solution definition in [[def-na-evolutionary-incompressible-ns-weak-solution]]. For fixed data $(u_0,f)$, energy weak solutions are unique when $d=2$. When $d=3$, if one of two energy weak solutions $v$ additionally belongs to $C^1([0,T];V_\sigma)$, has $\nabla v\in L^1(0,T;L^\infty(D))$, and its equation holds as an identity in $V_\sigma^*$ almost everywhere in time, then every other energy weak solution with the same data equals $v$. The three-dimensional conclusion is conditional on this strong branch and asserts no uniqueness between arbitrary energy weak solutions.

items.title: Well-definedness of the finite-dimensional mini backward Euler equations
items.statement: Assume Countable Choice. For each fixed finite mesh and time partition in [[def-na-mini-navier-stokes-backward-euler-scheme]], every term of its velocity equation is a continuous finite-dimensional functional of the trial and test vectors, the pressure constraints are linear, and the forcing averages exist.

items.title: Mean-zero pressure recovery from a solenoidal residual
items.statement: Assume Countable Choice and let $D$ be bounded, connected and Lipschitz. If $1<s<\infty$ and $R\in L^s(0,T;V^*)$ satisfies $R(t)(v)=0$ for every $v\in V_\sigma=\ker(\operatorname{div}:V\to L^2_0(D))$ outside one common null set, then there is a unique $p\in L^s(0,T;L^2_0(D))$ such that $R(t)(v)=b(v,p(t))$ for every $v\in V$ almost everywhere. Moreover, $\|p\|_{L^sL^2}\le C_{\rm div}(D)\|R\|_{L^sV^*}$.

items.title: The mini-element Fortin map approximates in L2
items.statement:
Let $\Pi_h:H^1_0(D;\mathbb R^d)\to V_h$ be the MINI Fortin map constructed in [[thm-na-mini-element-fortin-stability]]. On every shape-regular matching mesh, there is a constant $C$ independent of $h$ such that
$$\|v-\Pi_hv\|_{L^2(D)}\le Ch\|\nabla v\|_{L^2(D)}\qquad(v\in H^1_0(D;\mathbb R^d)).$$
For every fixed $v\in H^1_0(D)^d$, $\Pi_hv\to v$ in $H^1_0$ as $h\to0$. If $v\in V_\sigma$, exact Fortin preservation also gives $\Pi_hv\in Z_h$.

items.title: Backward Euler MINI step existence and discrete energy bound
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice, the mini-element hypotheses of [[def-na-mini-navier-stokes-backward-euler-scheme]], $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$, and an initial value $u_h^0\in Z_h$. On every finite positive time partition there is at least one mixed solution $(u_h^n,p_h^n)_{n=1}^N$ of the backward Euler scheme. Every such solution satisfies, for $0\le m\le N$, the work-form inequality
$$ rac12\|u_h^m\|_2^2+ rac12\sum_{n=1}^m\|u_h^n-u_h^{n-1}\|_2^2+
u\sum_{n=1}^m	au_n\|
abla u_h^n\|_2^2\le rac12\|u_h^0\|_2^2+\sum_{n=1}^m	au_n(f_h^n,u_h^n)_{L^2}.$$
Consequently it satisfies the mesh-independent estimate
$$ rac12\|u_h^m\|_2^2+ rac12\sum_{n=1}^m\|u_h^n-u_h^{n-1}\|_2^2+ rac{
u}{2}\sum_{n=1}^m	au_n\|
abla u_h^n\|_2^2\le rac12\|u_h^0\|_2^2+ rac{C_P(D)^2}{2
u}\|f\|_{L^2(0,T;L^2)}^2.$$
The constant is independent of mesh size and time-step sizes.

items.title: Strong L2 compactness for weakly solenoidal MINI trajectories
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$ be bounded, connected and polyhedral, $d=2$ or $3$. Let $\mathcal T_j$ be matching shape-regular meshes with $h_j\to0$, let $Z_j$ be the weak MINI divergence kernels, and let $0=t_0^j<\cdots<t_{N_j}^j=T$ have maximum step tending to zero. Suppose $U_j^n\in Z_j$, their piecewise-constant reconstructions $\overline U_j$ satisfy
$$\sup_j\left(\max_n\|U_j^n\|_{L^2}+\|\overline U_j\|_{L^2(0,T;H^1_0)}\right)<\infty,$$
and the following coefficient condition holds: for every finite $L^2$-orthonormal family $e_1,\ldots,e_m\in V_\sigma$, the $E$-valued piecewise-constant functions
$$Y_j(t)=\sum_{i=1}^m(U_j^n,\Pi_je_i)_{L^2}e_i\quad(t\in(t_{n-1}^j,t_n^j])$$
have uniformly bounded $L^2(0,T;E)$ norms and their backward difference quotients are bounded in $L^{4/3}(0,T;E)$; here $\Pi_j$ is the MINI Fortin map and $E=\operatorname{span}\{e_i\}$. Then $(\overline U_j)$ is relatively compact in $L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$.

items.title: Approximation by the MINI solenoidal energy projection
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice and the MINI mesh hypotheses. For $z\in V_\sigma$, define $S_hz\in Z_h$ by
$$a_\nu(S_hz,w_h)=a_\nu(z,w_h)\qquad(w_h\in Z_h).$$
This defines a unique linear projection and
$$\|z-S_hz\|_V\le\sqrt2\inf_{w_h\in Z_h}\|z-w_h\|_V.$$
If additionally $z\in H^2(D)^d$ and $q\in H^1(D)\cap L^2_0(D)$, then
$$\|z-S_hz\|_V\le C_0(1+\nu^{-1})h\bigl(\|z\|_{H^2(D)}+\|q\|_{H^1(D)}\bigr),$$
where $C_0$ is independent of $h$ and $\nu$ and depends on $D$, shape regularity and the uniform MINI inf-sup constant.

items.title: MINI backward Euler converges subsequentially to a solenoidal energy weak velocity
items.statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$, $d\in\{2,3\}$, be nonempty, bounded, connected, Lipschitz and polyhedral, and let $0<T<\infty$. Let $\{\mathcal T_j\}$ be matching shape-regular affine simplicial meshes with $h_j\to0$, and let the time partitions of $[0,T]$ have maximum step tending to zero, with no relation required between the two limits. Let $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$ and $u_0\in H_\sigma$. On each mesh take $u_j^0=P_{Z_j}u_0$, the $L^2$-orthogonal projection onto the weak MINI kernel, and choose any backward Euler MINI solution from [[thm-na-mini-be-step-existence-energy]]. Then a subsequence of piecewise-constant velocities converges strongly in $L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$ and weakly in $L^2(0,T;H^1_0(D)^d)$ to a velocity $u$ satisfying the solenoidal weak momentum equation, initial trace and energy inequality in [[def-na-solenoidal-energy-weak-ns-velocity]]. This theorem supplies the velocity limit and its energy inequality. It does not assert the pressure regularity and pressure-bearing formulation required by the PE06 plan; that remaining claim is recorded in [[rem-na-pe06-pressure-recovery-escalation]].

items.title: Smooth-branch velocity error for backward Euler MINI
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice. Assume the MINI mesh and time-partition hypotheses of [[def-na-mini-navier-stokes-backward-euler-scheme]]. Suppose $(u,p)$ is a strong solution of the no-slip Navier–Stokes equations with forcing $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$ and $u\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^2(D)^d\cap V_\sigma)$ and $p\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^1(D)\cap L^2_0(D))$. Set
$$M:=1+\|u\|_{W^{1,\infty}H^2}+\|p\|_{W^{1,\infty}H^1},\quad M_u:=\|u\|_{L^\infty V},$$
$$M_\infty:= igl(\|u_0\|_2^2+C_P(D)^2
u^{-1}\|f\|_{L^2L^2}^2 igr)^{1/2},\quad M_E:=
u^{-1/2}\|u_0\|_2+C_P(D)
u^{-1}\|f\|_{L^2L^2},$$
and $\Lambda:=1+C_D
u^{-3}M_u^4$, where $C_D$ depends only on the domain, dimension and the trilinear-form constant. For sufficiently fine time partitions satisfying $	au_{\max}\Lambda\le	frac12$, initialize by $u_h^0=P_{Z_h}u_0$ and choose any backward Euler MINI solution. Then
$$\max_{0\le n\le N}\|u(t_n)-u_h^n\|_2+
u^{1/2}\left(\sum_{n=1}^N	au_n\|u(t_n)-u_h^n\|_V^2ight)^{1/2}\le C_* igl(hM+	au_{\max}M^2 igr),$$
where one may take
$$C_*:=C_{D,\mathrm{shape}}(1+
u)^2(1+
u^{-4})(1+T)^2(1+M_\infty+M_E+M)^4\exp(2T\Lambda).$$
Here $f$ is the forcing of the strong solution and $C_{D,\mathrm{shape}}$ is independent of $h$, all time steps, and $
u$. The polynomial factor displays the positive and inverse viscosity powers produced by Young's inequalities and static Stokes projection. The explicit factor $
u^{-3}$ in $\Lambda$ and exponential dependence on $T\Lambda$ are retained; no Reynolds-uniform estimate is asserted. The corresponding pressure error estimate required by PE06 remains escalated in [[rem-na-pe06-pressure-recovery-escalation]].

items.title: PE06 pressure reconstruction and pressure-rate claims require another estimate
items.statement:
The PE06 scope in research/plan-numerical-spatial-track.md requires both (i) a pressure-bearing subsequential weak solution with $p\in L^{4/3}(0,T;L^2_0(D))$ and (ii) a smooth-branch velocity/pressure error bound. The proved subsequential result in [[thm-na-mini-navier-stokes-be-subsequential-limit]] reaches the time-dependent momentum equation only on $V_\sigma$; the proved smooth error estimate in [[thm-na-mini-be-smooth-velocity-error]] controls velocity only.

The abstract pressure result [[lem-na-continuous-pressure-recovery-from-solenoidal-residual]] is valid only after one has a known residual in $L^{4/3}(0,T;V^*)$ annihilating $V_\sigma$. The current limit proof supplies the time derivative only in $L^{4/3}(0,T;V_\sigma^*)$; extending that derivative by a divergence right inverse does not establish that the extension is the distributional derivative of $u$ on all of $V$. No pressure regularity follows from that extension alone.

For the discrete pressure rate, the MINI inf-sup estimate in [[thm-na-mini-element-h1-pressure-error]] controls $p_h$ from the full $V_h$ residual, which includes $(D_\tau u_h^n,v_h)_{L^2}$ for arbitrary $v_h\in V_h$. The energy argument bounds this derivative only against $Z_h$. The actual [[thm-na-discrete-helmholtz-projection-and-pressure-schur]] gives the $L^2$-orthogonal projector onto $Z_h$ but supplies no uniform $H^1$-stability bound; [[thm-na-mini-element-fortin-stability]] maps into $V_h$ and only maps solenoidal inputs into $Z_h$. Neither proves the missing full-test estimate.

**Affected claims:** the pressure-bearing conclusion of the PE06 subsequential-limit scope, including the $L^{4/3}_tL^2_0$ pressure gauge; and the pressure part of the PE06 smooth velocity/pressure error bound.

**Proposed local supplier and placement:** establish on the A page, before the pressure-bearing convergence and smooth pressure-error results, a uniform $H^1$-stable $L^2$-orthogonal projector $P_{Z_h}:V_h\to Z_h$ (or an alternative complete pressure estimate). Such a result would give $|(D_\tau u_h^n,v_h)|=|(D_\tau u_h^n,P_{Z_h}v_h)|$ and permit the pressure inf-sup estimate from the pressure-free kernel bound. The current draft does not assert that this supplier exists. Owner reconciliation is required before either pressure claim can be marked ready.

items.title: Fixing the spatially constant pressure mode
items.statement: On a bounded connected domain $D$, adding any spatial constant $c(t)$ to a pressure does not change the weak momentum equation with zero-boundary velocity tests. The condition $p(t)\in L^2_0(D)$ fixes that freedom uniquely.

items.title: The two-dimensional Taylor–Green vortex on the flat torus
A matching shape-regular MINI mesh family on the unit square
Zero-forcing discrete energy budget
items.statement:
Take $f=0$ and any initial weak-kernel velocity $u_h^0\in Z_h$. Every backward Euler MINI solution satisfies
$$\frac12\|u_h^m\|_2^2+\frac12\sum_{n=1}^m\|u_h^n-u_h^{n-1}\|_2^2+\nu\sum_{n=1}^m\tau_n\|\nabla u_h^n\|_2^2\le\frac12\|u_h^0\|_2^2.$$

items.title: A conditional three-dimensional computation with no uniqueness claim
items.statement:
Let $D=(0,1)^3$, $f=0$, and choose a nonzero $\chi\in C_c^\infty(0,1)$, for example a smooth bump supported in $(1/4,3/4)$. Put $\psi(x,y,z)=\chi(x)\chi(y)\chi(z)$ and
$$u_0=(\partial_y\psi,-\partial_x\psi,0).$$
This supplies explicit smooth no-slip data for a three-dimensional MINI backward Euler computation; initialize the discrete scheme with $u_h^0=P_{Z_h}u_0$.
